title: The stone head, the side
logline: The face from the side: the profile, a broken nose, the ear a hollow full of rain. The shingle wall's shadow across it at noon.

panels.composition: The carved head in profile from the left: a broken nose, a hollow ear holding rainwater, moss in the neck's fold, the shingle wall's noon shadow cutting across the cheek. Grass. Nothing else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a moss-grown carved stone head seen in profile with a broken nose and a hollow ear holding rainwater, a shingle wall's shadow across the cheek, grass, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: From the side. Rain in the ear.
